Arbitrage betting, or "arbing," is a strategy that enables finding the differences in odds among bookmakers. It involves placing bets on more than one possible outcome of an event, to take advantage of odds discrepancies, and result in a better success rate.

Sure - imagine this: DraftKings has the Patriots to win at +150 odds (which means bet $100 to win $150 profit) FanDuel has the Dolphins to win at +130 odds (which means bet $100 to win $130 profit) If you bet $100 on the Patriots to win on Draftkings, and $108.70 on the Dolphins to win on FanDuel, no matter who wins, you will end up with $41.30.

Because we tell you exactly how to place bet on both sides, you can watch your success everyday.
